name: Janet Yellen
role: Chair of the Federal Reserve (2014–2018); US Treasury Secretary (2021–2025)
summary: An economist who led the Federal Reserve and then the Treasury under Biden. Her recorded positions favor a progressive tax code, higher minimum wage, strong action on climate change, an independent central bank, alliance-based dealings with China, support for Ukraine and immigration as an economic benefit.
